title: On the Design Space of Continuous Diffusion Language Models
title_zh: 连续扩散语言模型（CDLMs）的设计空间

paragraphs.en: 1]University of Oxford 2]University of Amsterdam \metadata [Correspondence] Oscar Davis: oscar.davis@cs.ox.ac.uk , Marco Cuturi: m_cuturi@apple.com \metadata [Contributions] ∗ Work done while at Apple
paragraphs.zh: 1]牛津大学 2]阿姆斯特丹大学 \metadata [通信] Oscar Davis: oscar.davis@cs.ox.ac.uk , Marco Cuturi: m_cuturi@apple.com \metadata [贡献] ∗ 工作完成于苹果公司任职期间

paragraphs.en: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) promise to bring the benefits of continuous flow modelling to language, including accelerated sampling and controllable generation. The field has grown rapidly, and the capabilities of CDLMs have begun to rival those of discrete diffusion. Yet, unlike for continuous modalities such as images or videos, our grasp of the levers that matter when training CDLMs remains limited. In this work, we focus on two of these levers, namely self-conditioning and embedding geometry, and shed light on some of the mechanisms behind them, which in turn suggest cheaper and more effective designs. We begin by showing that self-conditioning corrects a train/inference mismatch by exposing the model to inference-like states that are otherwise rare during training. These gains can be recovered without an extra forward pass by a two-level interpolant, coined DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} , which improves TinyGSM accuracy more than threefold. Self-conditioning also aids in recognising tokens dominated by large-norm Gaussians—an issue known as token identifiability. To address it directly, we introduce discrete reveals to DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} , yielding SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} , which achieves discrete diffusion-level performance on TinyGSM, reaching 49.94 % 49.94\% with standard training hyperparameters and a tuned sampler. At the 1.7 1.7 B scale, SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} outperforms discrete diffusion on four of six likelihood-based evaluations, and surpasses one-hot flows on unconditional generation. On embedded spaces, we find that cross-entropy drives embeddings towards a geometry whose decoding error rate closely matches the one-hot one. We briefly explore a range of further options, such as hybrid corruption processes and noise schedules, including asynchronous ones. We believe this exploration can help the community better understand and advance the design space of CDLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 连续扩散语言模型（CDLMs）有望将连续流建模的优势引入语言领域，包括加速采样和可控生成。 该领域发展迅速，CDLMs 的能力已开始与离散扩散模型相媲美。 然而，与图像或视频等连续模态不同，我们在训练 CDLMs 时，对哪些关键因素起作用的理解仍然有限。 在本项工作中，我们聚焦于其中两个关键因素，即自条件化和嵌入几何结构，并揭示了其背后的一些机制，这些机制反过来也提出了更廉价且更有效的模型设计。 我们首先指出，自条件化通过让模型接触训练阶段罕见、但推理阶段常见的状态，从而修正了训练与推理之间的不匹配问题。 无需额外的前向传播，通过一种名为 DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} 的双层插值器，即可恢复这些性能提升，它将 TinyGSM 的准确率提升了三倍多。 自条件化还有助于识别那些受大范数高斯分布主导的标记——这是一个被称为“标记可识别性”的问题。 为直接解决这一问题，我们在 DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} 中引入了离散揭示机制，形成了 SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat}；在 TinyGSM 上，它达到了与离散扩散模型相当的性能，使用标准训练超参数和调优后的采样器时准确率可达 49.94\%。 在 1.7 B 规模下，SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 在六项基于似然度的评估中有四项优于离散扩散模型，并在无条件生成任务中超越了一热流模型。 在嵌入空间中，我们发现交叉熵会将嵌入向量引导至一种几何结构，其解码错误率与一热模型的错误率高度一致。 我们还简要探索了更多其他可能性，例如混合扰动过程、噪声调度方案，以及异步噪声调度方案。 我们相信，这一探索将有助于整个社区更好地理解并推动 CDLMs 的设计空间发展。

paragraphs.en: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) hold several promises for text generation. Ideally, they should port to the world of language modelling all of the key properties of the continuous toolbox, such as fast and controllable generation, consistency models ( Song et al., 2023 ; Geng et al., 2025 ; Boffi et al., 2025b ) , or stochastic optimal control-based steering ( Potaptchik et al., 2026a ; Holderrieth et al., 2026 ; Potaptchik et al., 2025 ) . Yet, some of the seminal advances that have managed to shrink the performance gap between continuous and discrete diffusion methods have relied instead on adaptations that deviate significantly from the continuous diffusion literature. One such technique is self-conditioning ( Chen et al., 2023 ) , which augments inputs using previous outputs, costing an additional forward pass during training. Yoo et al. (2026) interpret self-conditioning as a fixed-point iteration, and Shabalin et al. (2026) understand it through the lens of multi-modality. Yet, it remains unclear which deficiencies of CDLMs it corrects, and whether these can be addressed more cheaply. Another innovative line of development lies in embedded methods ( Deschenaux and Gulcehre, 2026 ; Chemseddine et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Batzolis et al., 2026 ) , which alleviate the computational and memory cost of one-hot methods ( Roos et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Potaptchik et al., 2026b ) . They rely on carefully chosen noise schedules. However, it remains unclear how such schedules interact with the learnt embeddings.
paragraphs.zh: 连续扩散语言模型（CDLMs）在文本生成方面展现出多项潜力。 理想情况下，它们应将连续工具箱的所有关键特性迁移到语言建模领域，例如快速且可控的生成、一致性模型（Song et al., 2023；Geng et al., 2025；Boffi et al., 2025b），或基于随机最优控制的引导方法（Potaptchik et al., 2026a；Holderrieth et al., 2026；Potaptchik et al., 2025）。 然而，一些成功缩小连续扩散方法与离散扩散方法之间性能差距的开创性进展，反而依赖于与连续扩散文献存在显著差异的改编方案。 其中一种技术是自条件化（Chen et al., 2023），它利用先前输出增强输入，但在训练期间需要额外进行一次前向传播。Yoo et al. （2026）将自条件化解释为一种不动点迭代，而 Shabalin et al. （2026）则从多模态的角度对其进行理解。 然而，目前尚不清楚它修正了 CDLMs 的哪些缺陷，以及这些缺陷是否可以通过更经济的方式解决。 另一条创新的研究方向是嵌入方法（Deschenaux and Gulcehre, 2026；Chemseddine et al., 2026；Hu et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026；Batzolis et al., 2026），它们降低了独热方法（Roos et al., 2026；Lee et al., 2026；Potaptchik et al., 2026b）的计算和内存成本。 这些方法依赖于精心选择的噪声调度方案。 然而，目前尚不清楚这类调度方案如何与学习到的嵌入向量相互作用。

paragraphs.en: In this work , we show first that self-conditioning addresses a discrepancy between inference- and train-time trajectories ( Section 3.1 ), and increases the density of otherwise under-sampled regions at train-time (consistent with Shabalin et al. 2026 ). This gain can be recovered by a simple two-level interpolant, called DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} , which requires no additional forward pass of the model, and which more than triples the accuracy on TinyGSM ( Liu et al., 2023 ) from 4.42 % 4.42\% to 16.00 % \mathbf{16.00\%} . Moreover, we find that self-conditioning helps in token identifiability ( Pynadath et al., 2026 ) ( Section 4.3 ): given the noisy state, the model cannot easily identify the expected endpoint of the trajectory, due to the norm mismatch between the noise and the token’s embedding, whereas self-conditioning is supported on the convex hull formed by the embeddings. Replacing that signal with a better representation of the state recovers a substantial part of the performance gain at no additional training cost.
paragraphs.zh: 在本项工作中，我们首先表明，自条件化解决了推理阶段与训练阶段轨迹之间的差异（第 3.1 节），并提高了训练阶段原本采样不足区域的密度（与 Shabalin 等人 2026 年的研究一致）。 这种性能提升可以通过一种名为 DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} 的简单两级插值器恢复，该方法无需对模型进行额外的前向传播，并使 TinyGSM（Liu 等人，2023）上的准确率从 4.42 % 4.42\% 提升至超过三倍的 16.00 % \mathbf{16.00\%}。 此外，我们发现自条件化有助于提升标记的可识别性（Pynadath 等人，2026）（第 4.3 节）：在给定噪声状态时，由于噪声与标记嵌入之间的范数不匹配，模型难以轻易识别轨迹的预期终点；而自条件化则基于嵌入所形成的凸包来提供支持。 用对状态更优的表示替代该信号，可以在不产生额外训练成本的情况下恢复大部分性能提升。

paragraphs.en: We address the token identifiability issue in DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} ( Section 3.2 ). By introducing discrete stochastic reveals akin to CANDI ( Pynadath et al., 2026 ) , the model is able to condition correctly on parts of its context, helping identifiability. This method, called SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} (semi-continuous categorical flow), further boosts the performance up to 32.90 % \mathbf{32.90\%} , reaching the discrete diffusion baseline of about 33.74 % 33.74\% . Using standard hyperparameters on the task, and a confidence-based sampler, SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} reaches 49.94 % \mathbf{49.94\%} without any self-conditioning . At the 1.7 1.7 B scale, SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} outperforms discrete diffusion models on 4 4 out of 6 6 likelihood-based benchmarks and matches them on a fifth one; it also surpasses one-hot flows in unconditional generation quality ( Figure 5 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们解决了 DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} 中的标记可识别性问题（第 3.2 节）。 通过引入类似于 CANDI（Pynadath 等人，2026）的离散随机揭示机制，模型能够正确对其上下文的部分内容进行条件约束，从而提升可识别性。 这种方法被称为 SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat}（半连续类别流），进一步将性能提升至 32.90 % \mathbf{32.90\%}，接近离散扩散基线模型约 33.74 % 33.74\% 的水平。 在该任务上使用标准超参数和基于置信度的采样器后，SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 无需任何自条件约束即可达到 49.94 % \mathbf{49.94\%}。 在 1.7 1.7 B 规模下，SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 在 6 个基于似然的基准测试中优于 4 个离散扩散模型，并在第五个基准测试中与它们表现相当；它在无条件生成质量方面也超越了 one-hot 流（图 5）。

paragraphs.en: We also cover embedded methods. Because of architectural decisions, one-hot flows effectively operate on an embedded space with an anisotropic noise defined by the embeddings’ geometry ( Section 4.1 ), on which we can directly train . We demonstrate that embeddings may not be trained with cross-entropy naively, as it maximises their spread. This itself induces a one-hot-like geometry on the embedded space when considering its corresponding decoding error rate ( Section 4.2 ). This may explain why carefully crafted schedules are needed. We argue that training should update the geometry of all embeddings jointly.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还涵盖了嵌入方法。 由于架构决策，one-hot 流实际上是在一个嵌入空间上运行的，该空间的各向异性噪声由嵌入的几何结构定义（第 4.1 节），我们可以在其上直接进行训练。 我们证明，不能简单地使用交叉熵来训练嵌入，因为这会最大化它们的分布。 当考虑其对应的解码错误率时，这本身会在嵌入空间上产生一种类似 one-hot 的几何结构（第 4.2 节）。 这可能解释了为何需要精心设计的调度方案。 我们认为，训练应联合更新所有嵌入的几何结构。

sents.en: We also cover embedded methods.
sents.zh: 我们还涵盖了嵌入方法。

sents.en: Because of architectural decisions, one-hot flows effectively operate on an embedded space with an anisotropic noise defined by the embeddings’ geometry ( Section 4.1 ), on which we can directly train .
sents.zh: 由于架构决策，one-hot 流实际上是在一个嵌入空间上运行的，该空间的各向异性噪声由嵌入的几何结构定义（第 4.1 节），我们可以在其上直接进行训练。

sents.en: We demonstrate that embeddings may not be trained with cross-entropy naively, as it maximises their spread.
sents.zh: 我们证明，不能简单地使用交叉熵来训练嵌入，因为这会最大化它们的分布。

sents.en: This itself induces a one-hot-like geometry on the embedded space when considering its corresponding decoding error rate ( Section 4.2 ).
sents.zh: 当考虑其对应的解码错误率时，这本身会在嵌入空间上产生一种类似 one-hot 的几何结构（第 4.2 节）。

sents.en: This may explain why carefully crafted schedules are needed.
sents.zh: 这可能解释了为何需要精心设计的调度方案。

sents.en: We argue that training should update the geometry of all embeddings jointly.
sents.zh: 我们认为，训练应联合更新所有嵌入的几何结构。

paragraphs.en: Lastly, we briefly explore other avenues such as asynchronous schedules, dynamic time allocation, hybrid methods, and acceleration, thus covering a large part of the design space of CDLMs. We believe that our results on our benchmarks show the promise of continuous and hybrid methods, and unveil important avenues left to explore to understand continuous diffusion for discrete data.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们简要探讨了其他途径，例如异步时间表、动态时间分配、混合方法和加速技术，从而涵盖了CDLMs设计空间的大部分内容。 我们相信，我们在基准测试上获得的结果展示了连续和混合方法的潜力，并揭示了在理解离散数据的连续扩散方面仍需探索的重要方向。

sents.en: Lastly, we briefly explore other avenues such as asynchronous schedules, dynamic time allocation, hybrid methods, and acceleration, thus covering a large part of the design space of CDLMs.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we identify two issues that one-hot flows suffer from. First, they lack trajectory ambiguity: they are trained on clean sequences at t ≈ 1 t\approx 1 , which mismatches the statistics of their inference trajectories. Second, they are unable to identify the tokens that they are generating, which we attribute to the high norm Gaussian noise. We show two simple interventions, DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} and SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} , respectively, both of which drastically improve the resulting performance.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们指出了 one-hot 流所存在的两个问题。 首先，它们缺乏轨迹模糊性：它们在 t ≈ 1 的干净序列上进行训练，这与推理轨迹的统计特性不匹配。 其次，它们无法识别自身生成的 token，我们认为这是由高范数的高斯噪声所致。 我们分别展示了两种简单的干预方法：DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} 和 SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat}，这两种方法都能显著提升最终性能。

paragraphs.en: We mostly rely on TinyGSM ( Liu et al., 2023 ) : the model is trained on generating Python solutions to grade school mathematical problems, and is then evaluated on GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) . To understand failure modes of trained models, we measure the percentage of programs that run, the percentage that have name errors (referencing non-existent variables), and the final accuracy. We use the settings of Kim et al. (2026) . Finally, retained methods are also evaluated on the standard OpenWebText (OWT) ( Gokaslan and Cohen, 2019 ) unconditional generation task on which we report the generative perplexity (Gen. PPL) as measured by GPT-2 ( Radford et al., 2019 ) alongside the entropy of generated samples, reported as Pareto fronts. See Section E.1 for more detail. As baselines, we provide masked discrete diffusion (MDM) and uniform-state diffusion (USDM), for discrete diffusion models, and FMLM+ ( Agarwal et al., 2026 ) and CANDI ( Pynadath et al., 2026 ) for hybrid methods. We retrain all baselines under the same settings, and report those numbers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们主要依赖 TinyGSM（Liu 等人，2023）：该模型通过在生成解决小学数学问题的 Python 代码上进行训练，随后在 GSM8K（Cobbe 等人，2021）上进行评估。为了理解训练后模型失效的模式，我们测量了可运行程序的百分比、存在命名错误（引用不存在的变量）的程序的百分比以及最终准确率。我们采用了 Kim 等人（2026）的设置。最后，我们还对保留的方法在标准的 OpenWebText（OWT）（Gokaslan 和 Cohen，2019）无条件生成任务上进行了评估，并报告了由 GPT-2（Radford 等人，2019）测量的生成困惑度（Gen. PPL），以及以帕累托前沿形式报告的生成样本的熵值。更多细节请参见 E.1 节。作为基线方法，对于离散扩散模型，我们提供了掩码离散扩散（MDM）和均匀状态扩散（USDM）；对于混合方法，则提供了 FMLM+（Agarwal 等人，2026）和 CANDI（Pynadath 等人，2026）。我们在相同的设置下重新训练了所有基线模型，并报告了相应的数值。

paragraphs.en: Gaps in training coverage seem to be more benign for continuous data, but costly for discrete data, which DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} partially addresses by placing training mass in those regions.
paragraphs.zh: 训练覆盖范围的缺失对于连续数据而言似乎影响较小，但对于离散数据则代价高昂；而 DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} 通过在那些区域分配训练权重，部分解决了这一问题。

paragraphs.en: Despite the improvement offered by DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} , the model still heavily suffers from name errors ( 30.02 % 30.02\% ). We attribute this to token identifiability ( Pynadath et al., 2026 ) : when referencing another variable, the model struggles to identify current tokens because of the large noise in x t x_{t} , and therefore cannot condition on it precisely: the Gaussian noise has an expected norm | V | \sqrt{{\left\lvert V\right\rvert}} , but the signal has a norm of 1 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} 带来了改进，但该模型仍然严重受到名称错误的影响（30.02% 30.02\%）。 我们将此归因于标记的可识别性（Pynadath 等人，2026）：在引用另一个变量时，由于 x t x_{t} 中存在大量噪声，模型难以识别当前标记，因此无法对其精确施加条件：高斯噪声的期望范数为 | V | \sqrt{{\left\lvert V\right\rvert}} ，而信号的范数则为 1 1 。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate this issue, we add a revealing mechanism akin to the one in CANDI: at random times τ ℓ \tau^{\ell} , a token is revealed as a one-hot input. This way, the model can cleanly condition on revealed inputs. The resulting method is SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} .

paragraphs.en: For better comparison, we also train SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} with more standard hyperparameters (including batch size 512 512 and 250 250 k training steps, see Section E.1 and Table 5 ). paragraphs.zh: 为了更准确地进行比较，我们还使用更标准的超参数（包括批量大小为 512 和训练步数为 250,000 步）对 SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 进行了训练（参见第 E.1 节和第 5 表）。 使用简单的采样器时，我们达到了 38.67% \mathbf{38.67\%}。 自适应噪声分配（Raya 等人，2026，InfoNoise）将我们的性能进一步提升至 41.09% \mathbf{41.09\%}，而经过更精细调优的基于置信度的采样器则使 SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 能够达到 49.94% \mathbf{49.94\%}。

paragraphs.en: While SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} obtains high performance, its stochastic reveals and piecewise continuous trajectories make it a harder candidate to accelerate using typical continuous techniques. We discuss in Section G.2 the possibility of designing asynchronous schedules ( i.e. , schedules per token position, ℓ \ell ) to alleviate this issue. Besides, we briefly explore more general hybrid corruption processes in Section E.5 , and show that SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} can obtain competitive performance compared to FMLM+ when distilling our model using D-MMD ( Hoogeboom et al., 2026 ; Salimans et al., 2024 ) in Section E.6 , in the few-step regime.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管 SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 取得了高性能，但其随机揭示和分段连续轨迹使其难以通过典型的连续技术进行加速。 我们在 G.2 节中讨论了设计异步调度（即每个词元位置的调度，ℓ \ell）的可能性，以缓解这一问题。 此外，我们在 E.5 节中简要探讨了更通用的混合腐蚀过程，并在 E.6 节中表明，在少步机制下，使用 D-MMD（Hoogeboom et al., 2026; Salimans et al., 2024）对我们的模型进行蒸馏时，SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 能够与 FMLM+ 相比获得具有竞争力的性能。

paragraphs.en: One-hot flows are costly, especially given that modern LM vocabulary sizes can exceed 200 200 k tokens, and incur a large memory and computational penalty, requiring the materialisation and manipulation of an L × | V | L\times{\left\lvert V\right\rvert} tensor per data point in a batch. It is therefore natural to depart from this representation and work on smaller embedded spaces. We show that their DER can become problematic with pure cross-entropy training, and that self-conditioning aids in token identifiability.
paragraphs.zh: One-hot 编码的流成本高昂，尤其是考虑到现代语言模型（LM）的词汇表规模可能超过 200,000 个词元，这会带来巨大的内存和计算开销，要求对批次中每个数据点都实例化和操作一个 L × |V| 的张量。 因此，放弃这种表示方式，转而使用更小的嵌入空间是合乎情理的。 我们证明了，在纯交叉熵训练下，它们的 DER 可能会出现问题，而自条件化有助于提升词元的可识别性。

paragraphs.en: The axis that helps us understand these results is the training objective. The simple cross entropy objective of the ambient sphere is pathological in two ways: (i) The model only updates the embeddings of the tokens involved in the batch, thus not updating the entire geometry of ℰ \mathcal{E} . Proposition 1 exhibits that the DER ( 4.3 ) depends solely on the interactions 𝖾𝗆𝖻 ⁡ ( j ) − 𝖾𝗆𝖻 ⁡ ( i ) \mathsf{emb}(j)-\mathsf{emb}(i) and ⟨ 𝖾𝗆𝖻 ⁡ ( i ) , 𝖾𝗆𝖻 ⁡ ( j ) ⟩ \langle\mathsf{emb}(i),\mathsf{emb}(j)\rangle for any i , j ∈ V i,j\in V . In Section F.3 , we show informally that, under a Bayes-optimal denoiser, the cross-entropy pushes only the true token’s embedding away from the posterior-mean embedding ( i.e. , away from the tokens it is confused with). paragraphs.en: We train a larger SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} model following the protocol of Davis et al. (2026) ; Sahoo et al. (2026) closely: the architecture is the same DiT ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ; Lou et al., 2024 ) with 1.7 1.7 B parameters, trained on the Nemotron Pretraining dataset ( Basant et al., 2025 ) for 2.1 2.1 T tokens using the TikToken tokeniser ( OpenAI, 2023 ) , with sequences of length 2048 2048 . We use 256 × 256\times H100 GPUs for the pre-training run with a batch size of 10 10 per GPU. We also train a one-hot flow baseline on the same settings ( Davis et al., 2026 ) . See Section E.1 for more details.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our model over the same multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) benchmarks as in Davis et al. (2026) ; Sahoo et al. (2026) : ARC-easy ( Clark et al., 2018 ) , BoolQ ( Clark et al., 2019 ) , OBQA ( Mihaylov et al., 2018 ) , PIQA ( Bisk et al., 2019 ) , RACE ( Lai et al., 2017 ) and SIQA ( Sap et al., 2019 ) . Instead of using an ELBO, we find the plain cross-entropy loss to be a better proxy for the likelihood for both the one-hot flow and SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 Davis et al. (2026) 和 Sahoo et al. (2026) 使用的相同多选问题回答（MCQA）基准数据集上对我们的模型进行了评估，包括 ARC-easy (Clark et al., 2018)、BoolQ (Clark et al., 2019)、OBQA (Mihaylov et al., 2018)、PIQA (Bisk et al., 2019)、RACE (Lai et al., 2017) 和 SIQA (Sap et al., 2019)。与使用 ELBO 不同，我们发现对于 one-hot flow 和 SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat}，普通的交叉熵损失是似然度的更优代理。

paragraphs.en: The results are available in Table 3 . SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} outperforms our one-hot flow baseline on every MCQA task, and outperforms the discrete diffusion baselines on ARC-E by 8.4 8.4 points, on BoolQ by 2.0 2.0 , PIQA by 7.6 7.6 , and on SIQA by 1.2 1.2 . On OBQA, our results are behind by 2.8 2.8 points, and we slightly exceed Duo and MDLM on RACE ( + 0.3 +0.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 结果见表 3。 SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 在所有 MCQA 任务上的表现均优于我们的 one-hot flow 基线模型，并且在 ARC-E 上比离散扩散基线模型高出 8.4 分，在 BoolQ 上高出 2.0 分，在 PIQA 上高出 7.6 分，在 SIQA 上高出 1.2 分。 在 OBQA 上，我们的结果落后 2.8 分；而在 RACE 上，我们略微超过了 Duo 和 MDLM（+0.3）。

PPL/Entropy Pareto frontiers provided in Figure 5 . We generate sequences of 2048 2048 tokens, and sweep over NFEs and temperature. The Gen. PPL is computed using Qwen 2.5 2.5 7 7 B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . At all NFEs, SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} dominates the one-hot flow baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循 Davis 等人（2026）的设置，SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 在无条件生成任务上的表现优于 one-hot 流方法，这一结论基于图 5 中提供的生成 PPL/熵帕累托前沿。我们生成了包含 2048 个标记的序列，并对 NFE 和温度进行了遍历分析。生成 PPL 是使用 Qwen 2.5 7B（Yang 等人，2025）计算的。在所有 NFE 设置下，SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 均优于 one-hot 流基线方法。

paragraphs.en: Gaussian interpolation on one-hot encodings was introduced from a variational perspective in VFM ( Eijkelboom et al., 2025 ) , and has been shown to be amenable to self-distillation and steering by CFM/FMLM/DFM ( Roos et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026 ; Potaptchik et al., 2026b ) . Yoo et al. (2026) analyse self-conditioning through a fixed-point iteration lens; Shabalin et al. (2026) do so through that of multi-modality.
paragraphs.zh: VFM（Eijkelboom 等人，2025）从变分角度引入了一种基于 one-hot 编码的高斯插值方法，并且已有研究表明该方法适用于通过 CFM/FMLM/DFM（Roos 等人，2026；Lee 等人，2026；Potaptchik 等人，2026b）进行自蒸馏和引导。Yoo 等人 （2026）通过固定点迭代的角度分析了自条件化；Shabalin 等人 （2026）则通过多模态的角度进行了分析。

paragraphs.en: Since those advances, 𝕊 \mathbb{S} -FLM and von Mises-Fisher flows ( Deschenaux and Gulcehre, 2026 ; Chemseddine et al., 2026 ) were the first to show reasonable performance on TinyGSM for continuous methods, by flowing on the sphere but by taking different probability path constructions. In parallel, geometrically simpler approaches have been developed. LangFlow ( Chen et al., 2026 ) use a simple linear projection, and ELF ( Hu et al., 2026 ) attempt learnt embeddings but have found using a pre-trained encoder to be much more effective. Meshchaninov et al. (2026) show how to leverage a pretrained AR model to obtain strong embeddings.
paragraphs.zh: 自这些进展以来，𝕊 \mathbb{S} -FLM 和 von Mises-Fisher 流（Deschenaux 和 Gulcehre，2026；Chemseddine 等，2026）首次展示了在连续方法上对 TinyGSM 的合理性能，它们通过在球面上流动但采用不同的概率路径构造来实现这一点。 与此同时，几何上更简单的方法也得到了发展。 LangFlow（Chen 等，2026）使用简单的线性投影，而 ELF（Hu 等，2026）尝试了学习嵌入，但发现使用预训练编码器要有效得多。Meshchaninov 等 （2026）展示了如何利用预训练的 AR 模型来获得强大的嵌入。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we show that self-conditioning aids in two important aspects of CDLMs: trajectory ambiguity (increasing the density of inference-like points at train time) and token identifiability (the ability to identify the expected endpoint of the trajectory given its current state). For the former, DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} can recover a large part of those benefits; for the latter, providing a better representation of the state, such as feeding the analytically available Bayesian posterior, helps substantially at a lower cost. We show that one-hot methods in fact evolve over an embedded space with anisotropic noise, while embedded methods trained naively recover one-hot properties in terms of their DER. SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} , a hybrid method, can attain discrete-diffusion-level performance on our benchmarks. At scale, SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} outperforms discrete diffusion on four out of six of our likelihood tasks, and surpasses one-hot flows on unconditional generation. We leave to future work accelerating these methods with the continuous toolbox, and understanding how that toolbox interacts with our design choices.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们证明了自我条件化有助于 CDLMs 的两个重要方面：轨迹模糊性（在训练时增加类似推理的点的密度）和标记可识别性（根据当前状态确定轨迹预期终点的能力）。 对于前者，DoubleCat \mathrm{DoubleCat} 可以恢复其中大部分优势；而对于后者，提供更优的状态表示（例如输入解析上可用的贝叶斯后验分布），能以更低的成本带来显著帮助。 我们证明了，one-hot 方法实际上是在一个具有各向异性噪声的嵌入空间中演化，而未经特殊训练的嵌入方法则会在 DER 方面恢复 one-hot 特性。 SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 是一种混合方法，在我们的基准测试中能够达到离散扩散模型水平的性能。 在大规模场景下，SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 在六个可能性任务中的四个上优于离散扩散模型，并在无条件生成任务中超越了 one-hot 流方法。 我们将使用连续工具箱加速这些方法，以及研究该工具箱如何与我们的设计选择相互作用，留待未来工作完成。

paragraphs.en: Latent Thought Flow ( Prabhudesai and Geng, 2026 ) explores the idea of compressing the sequence length. We believe that this general direction is also very promising, but the exploration thereof should be deferred to another dedicated work. Other works consider using an existing strong AR model for encoding, such as Meshchaninov et al. (2026) , which uses the contextual embeddings of GPT-2 ( Radford et al., 2019 ) . While offering better performance, the approach is naturally more expensive computationally at train time.
paragraphs.zh: 潜在思维流（Prabhudesai 和 Geng，2026）探讨了压缩序列长度的想法。我们认为这一总体方向同样极具前景，但对其的探索应留待另一项专门研究。其他工作则考虑使用现有的强大自回归模型进行编码，例如 Meshchaninov 等人（2026），他们使用了 GPT-2（Radford 等人，2019）的上下文嵌入。尽管这种方法能带来更好的性能，但它在训练阶段的计算成本自然也更高。

paragraphs.en: Besides CANDI ( Pynadath et al., 2026 ) and FMLM+ ( Agarwal et al., 2026 ) , we note also the existence of the literature of discrete diffusion with continuous augmentations, for instance via latents ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Concurrently, Jutras-Dubé et al. (2026) formalised these hybrids, together with masked and continuous diffusion, as special cases of a single process on the embedding space. Tokens form discrete anchors that the reverse process can jump onto, and the forward process determines when and where those jumps happen. In their framework, the CANDI-style hybrid underlying SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} is recovered as the identity-kernel case. We see this as a principled way to design hybrid corruption processes, complementary to the variants we explore in Section E.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 除了 CANDI（Pynadath 等人，2026）和 FMLM+（Agarwal 等人，2026），我们还注意到离散扩散结合连续增强这一领域的文献，例如通过潜在变量实现的方案（Zheng 等人，2025；Zhou 等人，2026）。 与此同时，Jutras-Dubé 等人 （2026）将这些混合模型与掩码扩散和连续扩散一起形式化为嵌入空间中单一过程的特殊情形。 词元构成离散的锚点，反向过程可以跳跃至这些锚点，而正向过程则决定这些跳跃发生的时间和位置。 在他们的框架中，SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 所依赖的 CANDI 风格混合模型可被还原为恒等核情形。 我们认为这是一种设计混合腐蚀过程的系统性方法，与我们在 E.5 节中探索的变体形成互补。

paragraphs.en: The sampling algorithm for SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} is provided in Algorithm 1 . It follows the sampling procedure of CANDI ( Pynadath et al., 2026 ) . Moreover, we propose Algorithm 2 for a more sophisticated sampling scheme, which mostly introduces DDIM-style ( Song et al., 2022 ) renoising, and confidence-based “remasking” (return to continuous state) inspired by the procedure of ReMDM ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 的采样算法见算法 1。 它遵循 CANDI（Pynadath 等人，2026）的采样流程。 此外，我们提出了算法 2，用于实现更复杂的采样方案，该方案主要引入了 DDIM 风格（Song 等人，2022）的去噪方法，以及受 ReMDM（Wang 等人，2026）流程启发的基于置信度的“重新掩码”（返回连续状态）。

paragraphs.en: The model is thus effectively exposed to various levels α \alpha of additional discrete corruption, recovering CANDI at α = 0 \alpha=0 . Simply put, at each position, the model flows towards either a random vertex with probability α \alpha or to the true one otherwise, until its reveal time τ ℓ \tau^{\ell} . We report the TinyGSM results in Table 10 . As we can see, with increasing α \alpha , we recover better performance until α = 0.75 \alpha=0.75 as it recovers the effect of SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} . Nonetheless, for α = 1 \alpha=1 , the model learns a leave-one-out denoiser; that is to say, it learns 𝔼 ⁡ [ X 1 ℓ ∣ I t − ℓ = x t − ℓ ] \mathbb{E}[X_{1}^{\ell}\mid I_{t}^{-\ell}=x_{t}^{-\ell}] , which ignores position ℓ \ell to predict token ℓ \ell , like discrete diffusion methods ( Gourevitch et al., 2026 ) . This is natural, since I ⁡ ( I t ℓ , X 1 ℓ ) = 0 \mathrm{I}(I_{t}^{\ell};X_{1}^{\ell})=0 for t < τ ℓ t<\tau^{\ell} and α = 1 \alpha=1 , where I \mathrm{I} denotes mutual information. Variants with α > 0 \alpha>0 thus partially defy the purpose of hybrid methods, as they rely on discretely revealed positions.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，该模型实际上接触到了不同级别的额外离散破坏 α \alpha，并在 α = 0 \alpha=0 时恢复了 CANDI。 简单来说，在每个位置，模型会以概率 α \alpha 流向一个随机顶点，否则流向真实顶点，直到其揭示时间 τ ℓ \tau^{\ell}。 我们在表 10 中报告了 TinyGSM 的结果。 我们可以看到，随着 α \alpha 的增加，性能逐渐恢复，直到 α = 0.75 \alpha=0.75 时恢复了 SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 的效果。 尽管如此，当 α = 1 \alpha=1 时，模型会学习一种“留一法”去噪器；也就是说，它学习的是 𝔼 ⁡ [ X 1 ℓ ∣ I t − ℓ = x t − ℓ ] \mathbb{E}[X_{1}^{\ell}\mid I_{t}^{-\ell}=x_{t}^{-\ell}]，即忽略位置 ℓ \ell 来预测词元 ℓ \ell，这与离散扩散方法（Gourevitch 等人，2026）类似。 这是合理的，因为当 t < τ ℓ t<\tau^{\ell} 且 α = 1 \alpha=1 时，I ⁡ ( I t ℓ , X 1 ℓ ) = 0 \mathrm{I}(I_{t}^{\ell};X_{1}^{\ell})=0，其中 I \mathrm{I} 表示互信息。 因此，α > 0 \alpha>0 的变体部分违背了混合方法的目的，因为它们依赖于离散揭示的位置。

paragraphs.en: We apply D-MMD distillation ( Hoogeboom et al., 2026 ; Salimans et al., 2024 ) to our pre-trained SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} model. We tune the temperature of the teacher T T , and attempt some simple techniques such as sampling boundary pairs ( s , t ) = ( 0 , 1 ) (s,t)=(0,1) with a probability p p , and a gap curriculum updated every n n steps, both inspired by Lee et al. (2026) . We find that the resulting model is competitive with FMLM+ ( Agarwal et al., 2026 ) , and tends to have higher accuracy in the 1 1 -step and 32 32 -step case, while FMLM+ retains a consistent and balanced accuracy for different numbers of steps. Our results are obtained with simple naive sampling, and we hypothesise that more advanced samplers could further improve the performance ( e.g. , confidence-based).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 D-MMD 蒸馏方法（Hoogeboom 等人，2026；Salimans 等人，2024）应用于我们预训练的 SemiCat \mathrm{SemiCat} 模型。 我们调整教师模型 T 的温度，并尝试了一些简单技术，例如以概率 p 采样边界对 (s, t) = (0, 1)，以及每 n 步更新一次间隔课程；这些方法均受 Lee 等人（2026）的启发。 我们发现，所得模型与 FMLM+（Agarwal 等人，2026）具有竞争力，并且在 1 步和 32 步的情况下准确率往往更高，而 FMLM+ 在不同步数下仍能保持准确率的稳定与平衡。 我们的结果是通过简单的朴素采样获得的，我们推测更先进的采样器（例如基于置信度的采样器）可能能进一步提升性能。

paragraphs.en: Another observation which is consistent with our understanding from Section 4.3 is in Figure 8 . Observe that one can split the input projection matrix in two parts: the one that multiplies the usual input, W x W_{x} , and the one that multiplies the self-conditioning, W c W_{c} (see Section F.4 for additional detail). We can then measure the cosine similarity between their vectorised forms. For the first 80 80 k steps, the model converges to representations that are highly aligned (with a cosine similarity of 0.9 0.9 ), and the input projection thus amounts approximately to a linear combination followed by a common projection thereon. After that, the loss, performance and the embedding alignment of the model plateau for roughly 30 30 k iterations, and then continue improving anew when the cosine similarity drops down to 0.6 0.6 , alluding to the fact that the model learns a more complex function than a mere Euler-like step.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个与我们在第 4.3 节中的理解一致的现象可见于图 8。 可以观察到，输入投影矩阵可拆分为两部分：一部分与常规输入相乘，即 W x W_{x}；另一部分与自条件项相乘，即 W c W_{c}（更多细节请参见第 F.4 节）。 接着，我们可以测量它们向量化形式之间的余弦相似度。 在前 80k 个步骤中，模型会收敛到高度对齐的表示（余弦相似度为 0.9），因此输入投影大致相当于先进行线性组合，再对结果进行公共投影。 此后，模型的损失、性能以及嵌入对齐度在大约 30k 次迭代中趋于平稳；当余弦相似度下降至 0.6 时，它们又会重新开始改善，这表明模型学习到的函数比简单的欧拉式步骤更为复杂。

paragraphs.en: To return to a continuous and (conditionally on the endpoints) deterministic process, we note that the revealing procedure can be seen as a limiting case of asynchronous schedules with added randomness. Instead of having a single time for the evolution of the interpolant, we can have a distinct time for each position, t ℓ t^{\ell} . In principle, a schedule that depends on the current state or the model’s denoising distribution is appealing, as parts of the sequence may benefit from being committed earlier than others. Nonetheless, training such a schedule either requires two forward passes from the denoising model, π θ \pi^{\theta} , or training uniformly on the [ 0 , 1 ] L [0,1]^{L} hypercube to produce a model that is agnostic to the specific choice of schedule; but the latter exposes the model to sequences that have uninformative statistics for inference.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回归到一个连续且（在端点处有条件下）确定性的过程，我们注意到，揭示过程可以被视为添加了随机性的异步调度的极限情况。 与其让插值量的演化只有一个单一的时间点，不如为每个位置设定一个独立的时间 t ℓ t^{\ell}。 原则上，一种依赖当前状态或模型去噪分布的调度方案是颇具吸引力的，因为序列中的某些部分可能比其他部分更适合更早地确定下来。 然而，训练这样的调度方案要么需要两次来自去噪模型 π θ \pi^{\theta} 的前向传播，要么需要在 [0,1]^{L} 超立方体上进行均匀训练，以生成一个对具体调度选择无依赖的模型；但后一种方法会让模型接触到在推理中缺乏信息价值的序列。

paragraphs.en: We follow Wu et al. (2023) and the specific parametrisation by Bansal and Sanghavi (2026) . We introduce a global time t g t^{g} that we sample as before: according to some density p ⁡ ( t ) p(t) that is often to be taken uniform, but in the case of InfoNoise can be adapted dynamically during training. During inference we step uniformly in t g t^{g} . For each position ℓ = 1 , … , L \ell=1,\ldots,L we introduce a local time t ℓ = F ⁡ ( t g , ℓ ) t^{\ell}=F(t^{g},\ell) that is a function of the global time and the position. Each position ℓ \ell gets a fixed rank r ℓ ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) r_{\ell}\in(0,1) , given by r ℓ = 1 − ( ℓ − 0.5 ) / L r_{\ell}=1-(\ell-0.5)/L . The rank is then pushed through the quantile function of a Beta distribution whose mean is t g t^{g} : t ℓ = Q t ​ ( r ℓ ) t^{\ell}=Q_{t}(r_{\ell}) , where Q t Q_{t} is the quantile function of Beta ⁡ ( k / ( 1 − t ) , k / t ) \mathrm{Beta}(k/(1-t),k/t) where k k specifies its concentration: as k ⟶ ∞ k\longrightarrow\infty we recover a shared time t ℓ = t g t^{\ell}=t^{g} . As k ⟶ 0 k\longrightarrow 0 , Beta \mathrm{Beta} tends to a Bernoulli with mean t g t^{g} , so position ℓ \ell switches from noise to data exactly when t g t^{g} crosses ( ℓ − 0.5 ) / L (\ell-0.5)/L : a deterministic left-to-right reveal. In our experiments we use k = 1 k=1 ; the resulting local times are shown in Figure 11 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循 Wu 等人（2023）的研究，并采用 Bansal 和 Sanghavi（2026）提出的具体参数化方法。我们引入一个全局时间 t g t^{g}，其采样方式与之前相同：根据某个密度函数 p ⁡ ( t ) p(t) 进行采样，该密度函数通常取均匀分布，但在 InfoNoise 的情况下，可以在训练过程中动态调整。在推理阶段，我们以均匀步长推进 t g t^{g}。对于每个位置 ℓ = 1 , … , L \ell=1,\ldots,L，我们引入一个局部时间 t ℓ = F ⁡ ( t g , ℓ ) t^{\ell}=F(t^{g},\ell)，它是全局时间和位置的函数。每个位置 ℓ \ell 都被赋予一个固定的秩 r ℓ ∈ ( 0 , 1 ) r_{\ell}\in(0,1)，由 r ℓ = 1 − ( ℓ − 0.5 ) / L r_{\ell}=1-(\ell-0.5)/L 给出。随后，该秩通过一个 Beta 分布的分位数函数进行转换，其均值为 t g t^{g}：t ℓ = Q t ​ ( r ℓ ) t^{\ell}=Q_{t}(r_{\ell})，其中 Q t Q_{t} 是 Beta ⁡ ( k / ( 1 − t ) , k / t ) \mathrm{Beta}(k/(1-t),k/t) 的分位数函数，而 k k 决定了其集中程度：当 k ⟶ ∞ k\longrightarrow\infty 时，我们得到共享时间 t ℓ = t g t^{\ell}=t^{g}。而当 k ⟶ 0 k\longrightarrow 0 时，Beta \mathrm{Beta} 分布趋近于一个均值为 t g t^{g} 的伯努利分布，因此位置 ℓ \ell 会在 t g t^{g} 恰好穿过 ( ℓ − 0.5 ) / L (\ell-0.5)/L 时从噪声切换到数据：这是一种确定性的从左到右的揭示过程。在我们的实验中，我们使用 k = 1 k=1；由此得到的局部时间如图 11 所示。

paragraphs.en: Like Deschenaux and Gulcehre (2026) ; Batzolis et al. (2026) we adapt InfoNoise, the information-guided time allocation of Raya et al. (2026) , to the cross-entropy objective used in our model. The adaptation changes only the distribution π ⁡ ( t ) \pi(t) from which training times are sampled; the loss weighting itself remains fixed. Writing ℒ ¯ ​ ( t ) \bar{\mathcal{L}}(t) for the expected loss at time t t , the objective thus changes from ∫ 0 1 p ⁡ ( t ) ​ ℒ ¯ ​ ( t ) ​ 𝑑 t \int_{0}^{1}p(t)\bar{\mathcal{L}}(t)\,\mathrm{d}t to ∫ 0 1 π ⁡ ( t ) ​ ℒ ¯ ​ ( t ) ​ 𝑑 t \int_{0}^{1}\pi(t)\bar{\mathcal{L}}(t)\,\mathrm{d}t , where p p is the base (uniform) density.
